lines: Naynesh Kanubhai Patel, Promoter Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds by selling 4,98,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹4.93 to ₹5.23 crore are scheduled on or before Friday, November 06, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained promoter shares are an estimate of ₹69.32 to ₹73.52 crore, locked in for 12, 24 and 36 months from allotment.
Allotment date is unknown, so exact lock-in end dates cannot yet be confirmed.
